sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Which of the following is the natural satellite of the Earth?
Igloos are built by people living in which type of region?
Which raw material is primarily used to manufacture paper in factories?
Which of these activities is best for maintaining good physical health?
options: D) Sleeping for only three hours

questions.question_text: A pulley is a simple machine commonly used to do what?
options: A) Draw water from a deep well
B) Cut a piece of paper
questions.answer: A) Draw water from a deep well

questions.question_text: Camels are most commonly used for transport in which type of land?
Where are large quantities of clothes manufactured using heavy machines?
What is the huge ball of hot, glowing gases at the center of our solar system?
Which of these is a good habit for wellness and hygiene?
Which part of a bicycle helps the rider change its direction?
How does cotton from a field become a shirt? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Farmers grow cotton in fields, which is picked and spun into thread. The thread is woven into cloth in mills, and then stitched into a shirt.

questions.question_text: Why do stars look so tiny to us in the night sky? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Stars look very tiny to us because they are incredibly far away from the Earth. Even though they are huge, their great distance makes them look like dots.

questions.question_text: Why do houses in areas with heavy rainfall have sloping roofs? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Houses in these areas have sloping roofs so that heavy rainwater or snow can easily slide off the roof without damaging or flooding the house.

questions.question_text: Name two daily habits that help keep our teeth clean and healthy. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: To keep teeth healthy, we must brush them twice a day, once in the morning and once before bed, and rinse our mouth after every meal.

questions.question_text: Explain how a pair of scissors acts as a simple machine to help us. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A pair of scissors is a simple machine called a lever. It uses two sharp blades joined at a point to cut materials easily with less effort.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are an astronaut walking on the Moon. Describe what you see around you and how you move. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: Walking on the Moon, I see a dark sky with no clouds and a surface covered in deep craters and gray dust. Because there is less gravity, I cannot walk normally. Instead, I float and take long, high bouncy steps.

questions.question_text: Imagine you live in a dense, hot forest. Describe what you eat and the type of house you live in. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: Living in a dense, hot forest, I eat fresh fruits, roots, and berries gathered from the trees. My house is built on high wooden stilts to keep my family safe from dangerous wild animals and heavy floods during the rainy season.

questions.question_text: Describe the complete journey of how soft clay is converted into a beautiful painted earthen pot. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: First, a potter collects soft clay and mixes it with water to make it smooth. He then places the wet clay on a spinning potter's wheel, using his hands to shape it into a round pot. Once shaped, the pot is baked in a hot fire to make it strong, and finally painted.

questions.question_text: Explain how playing outdoor sports with friends contributes to both physical health and mental happiness. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Playing outdoor sports involves running and jumping, which makes our muscles strong, improves our stamina, and keeps our body completely fit. At the same time, playing together builds strong friendships, helps us learn teamwork, and makes our minds deeply happy and completely relaxed after a long day of studying.
